description: Live shared-mobility availability near WGS84 coordinates from sharedmobility.ch (SFOE national aggregator: PubliBike, Donkey Republic, Bolt, Voi, Tier, Mobility car sharing, carvelo cargo bikes, …). Returns free-floating vehicles and docking stations (with vehicles/docks available) sorted by distance, each with provider name, vehicle types, distance_m and battery range where published. Filter with vehicle_type: bike | e-bike | cargo_bike | scooter | moped | car. Example: {lat: 47.3779, lon: 8.5403, radius_m: 300, vehicle_type: 'scooter'} (Zürich HB). Use geocode first to turn an address into coordinates.

kind.description: Free-floating vehicles, docking stations, or both

only_available.description: Hide reserved/disabled vehicles and empty stations

vehicle_type.description: Only this kind of vehicle ('bike' = non-electric)

name: get_shared_vehicles_nearby
title: Shared bikes, e-scooters and cars near a point
